items.text: Baltimore FINAL: QB Lamar Jackson (thumb, placed on IR) OUT; QB Tyler Huntley (turf toe, season) OUT; S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) OUT. Questionable: CB Nate Wiggins (stinger/illness, DNP all week), RB Adam Randall (neck, full). Undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano starts, Kedon Slovis backup. LB Roquan Smith and DE Trey Hendrickson not on the final report. K Tyler Loop DNP.

Jacksonville FINAL: RB Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot, DNP all week) questionable - game-time decision, Chris Rodriguez Jr. would start; DE Travon Walker (ribs, limited) questionable. No Jaguars out/doubtful. WR Jakobi Meyers, G Ezra Cleveland, S Antonio Johnson limited but no game status. Trevor Lawrence starts.
